title: The AI Daily — Morning Conversation
blurb: An American-English dialogue limited to publisher feed excerpts.
lines: Hey, welcome to The AI Daily. I'm Maya, and Ben is here with me. We've picked a few headlines from publisher news feeds to talk through.
Hi, Maya. These are short feed excerpts, not the full articles, so we'll keep the facts carefully attributed and avoid filling in the blanks.
Let's start with TechCrunch AI. The headline is: Where was Nvidia’s security team.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including…
That brings us to The Decoder, which has this headline: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Days before what could be the largest IPO in history, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called buying compute 'the deepest business…
Next up, Google Gemini reports: Connect Google Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights.
According to the publisher's excerpt, All Gemini app users in the U.S. can connect Google Wallet to get responses informed by their spending habits.
And our fourth story is from The Verge: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO.
According to the publisher's excerpt, On January 6th, 2025, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang got his rockstar moment at last. He strode triumphantly onstage, hand raised…
Before we go, here's a useful expression: keep an eye on. It means watch something for changes — like a fast-moving AI story.
Exactly. And look into means investigate further. Follow the original reporting for context. See you in the next edition.
note: AI voices reading a conservative two-host script grounded only in publisher feed excerpts. Full article claims were not independently verified.
